svg.title: If their assumptions hold, five of the seven scenarios beyond the baseline would lift at least one outcome family by 2036.
svg.desc: A table of eight scenarios for 2036 against four outcome families: quality of democracy, government efficacy, economic performance, and income and wealth equality. Each cell gives the atlas’s direction words with Oath & Action’s arrow. Five of the seven scenarios beyond the baseline would lift at least one family if their assumptions hold, and in the baseline each family stays flat or falls. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. On a computer without both fonts, the labels fall back to another font and change width.
svg.text: Oath & Action’s reading, by arrow and tint
